contractSource: Description: "Convert Decimal and Shotok land units to Acre, Katha, Bigha, Square Feet, Square Meter, Hectare..." with a Regional Standard selector (Bangladesh, West Bengal, Bihar, Nepal).
groundTruth: 1 decimal = 1/100 acre = 435.6 sq ft (1 acre = 43,560 sq ft by definition). Katha in Bangladesh/West Bengal = 720 sq ft; in Bihar = 1,361.25 sq ft (1 Bihar bigha = 27,225 sq ft = 20 katha).

cases.derivation: 10 decimal × 435.6 = 4,356 sq ft. In Bangladesh 1 katha = 720 sq ft, so 4,356 ÷ 720 = 6.05 katha. In acres: 10 ÷ 100 = 0.1 acre.
Same 4,356 sq ft; a Bihar katha is 1,361.25 sq ft (27,225 sq ft per bigha ÷ 20), so 4,356 ÷ 1,361.25 = 3.2 katha exactly (1,361.25 × 3.2 = 4,356).
